items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Norris Turney quitting a band due to someone else's behavior; Interviewee only confirms with 'Uh-huh'.

ctx.x: And I said, "What is with this man?"
Well, he did a lot of strange things, like he got Norris Turney to quit by doubling the tempo behind him on his solos. Now, you say he played too slowly for you.
